description: Use when writing SolvaPay into existing code — not exploring options, but implementing. The trigger phrase: user has existing code and needs SolvaPay functionality built into it. Skip for greenfield paid MCP scaffold (create-mcp-app), Lovable paste-in checkout, or redirect-only checkout with no SDK work.
